launches.title: Aucert - AI agents that verify mobile apps autonomously
launches.tagline: Expert agents that do the actual testing - in less than 2 hours!
launches.body:
We are [Vivek](https://www.linkedin.com/in/viveksoneja/) and [Rajesh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rajeshkumar05/), co-founders of Aucert.

Testing mobile apps has always been slow, manual and error prone. Aucert solves this by deploying a team of expert AI agents that operate autonomously to ensure your app meets your expectations.

**TL;DR:** Aucert is an autonomous mobile app verification platform with a team of expert AI agents. Pick a build, start a scan, and the agents test it like a real user, then report what broke with the evidence: functional bugs, accessibility issues, design issues, and Google Play and App Store policy violations etc. What takes top apps weeks and multiple teams, Aucert does in hours.

<https://youtu.be/pd_mqx7HXNo>

**Why is mobile validation so hard?**

On the web, you roll back a bad release in minutes. On mobile, the bug sits on people's phones until they update, while the fix waits on a hotfix and another round of store review. Meanwhile, coding agents write code faster than any team can check it.

**How does Aucert work?**

Aucert’s mobile verification platform uses purpose built AI agents that evaluate your app from multiple lenses. Pax knows Google Play and App Store policy. Iris checks accessibility.  Genie uses the app like a real user, screen by screen. There are no test scripts to write: the agents learn the app on their own and hold every build to your team's standards.

Every finding comes with evidence, and your team decides what ships. What takes top apps weeks and multiple teams, Aucert does in hours.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=124025&key=user_uploads/3822644/7c1ce7e2-e227-4551-b969-1d59b99e99b4)

**How it fits your release?**

* **Nothing to set up.** No test scripts to write or maintain. The agents learn the app on their own.
* **Your standards.** The agents learn your expectations and suggest the ones you never wrote down. Nothing is enforced without your approval.
* **You make the call.** Every finding comes with evidence, and your team decides what ships.

**Who’s the team?**

Vivek Soneja and Rajesh Kumar have lived this problem from the inside. Vivek was the founding mobile architect at PhonePe (500M+ users) and worked on WhatsApp at Meta. Rajesh spent 11 years at PayPal and patented automated payments testing.

**Our Ask**

* **Shipping a mobile app with coding agents?** [**Book a demo**](https://www.aucert.ai/#book) and we'll show you what the agents find in your app.
* **Need performance or security checks?** They're next on our list. Tell us what you need.
* **Intros** to mobile engineering and QA leaders.
